That lets `[ResidualNetwork.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/ResidualNetwork.java:1)` focus only on residual capacities and augmentation, instead of also embedding traversal behavior.

`[MaxFlowSolver.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/032_ford_fulkerson_max_flow/MaxFlowSolver.java:1)` now depends on the `AugmentingPathFinder` abstraction and provides a default BFS implementation through constructor injection. That gives you a cleaner solver boundary and makes alternative search policies testable and swappable without changing solver code.
